text:
rachel: Heads up — sampling pipeline drifted this morning after the tiny deploy to sampler. We ingested ~18k examples from the low-latency annotator buckets (latency < 2s) which looks like it inverted the min-annotations gating. Seeing a +6% failure rate on the q4b quant canary (short-form intents). Anyone on curation or infra?
kevin: can you paste the query / logs? want to confirm which filter flipped.
rachel: sure — here's the shard query we ran for the ingest window: ```sql
SELECT bucket, count(*) as n, avg(annotator_latency_ms) as lat
FROM sample_ingest
WHERE ts >= '2025-12-01T08:00:00Z' AND source = 'labeler-queue'
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 50;```
rachel: result showed buckets 9/12/23 exploded with lat ~1800ms and a bunch at 300ms — looks like the "min_annotations" boolean in the deploy was accidentally toggled to false when we merged the fast-path patch.
liz: yup — we rolled a labeler routing tweak at 07:55 that rerouted backlog into the fast-path. I can freeze routing changes and pause auto-rebalance.
ben: quant note: q4b is sensitive to sample mix; if short, high-frequency intents dominate the golden/probe set, quantized kernels can amplify small distribution shifts and blow up accuracy. We should avoid changing the golden weighting until we stabilize sampling.
tara: can we add a quick stratified probe injection to make the canary reflect expected latency distribution? 10k probes across slow/med/fast would show if it's purely sampling skew.
kevin: timeline? how long to pause and inject probes? also, do we have rollback for the sampler deploy? ops-bot, any deploy logs?
ops-bot: deploy: sampler-service v2.17.1 -> v2.17.2 at 2025-12-01T07:55:12Z by liz (deploy-id: dpl-9853). No automatic rollback triggered.
liz: I can pause the routing change now and push a rollback within 10 minutes. I'll also open a ticket to revert the gating flag.
rachel: mitigation plan: 1) pause sampler routing (liz) 2) inject stratified probes (tara) 3) temporarily exclude today's ingest from canary evaluation (ben) 4) rerun canary with repaired gating and mixed probes (kevin + ben).
ben: agree. I can rerun the quant canary once probes are in — will likely take ~30-45m. If we still see >3% regression, we'll revert q4b and fall back to fp16 baseline.
tara: I'll prepare the probe payloads and a short script to inject seeds uniformly across latency buckets. attaching snippet: ```bash
# inject probes
python tools/inject_probes.py --seed-bank probe-seed-20251201 --buckets fast,med,slow --n 10000
```
kevin: copy. rachel — can you tag the ingest files to exclude from today’s canary until we’re cleared? a quick Provenance tag like `sampler-glitch-20251201` would help.
rachel: done — added tag sample_provenance:sampler-glitch-20251201 to the affected S3 prefixes and to the canary exclude list.
liz: rollout paused and rollback queued (dpl-9854). I'll message once it's live.
kevin: thanks everyone. please post canary results in this thread when ready.
rachel: will do. thanks :thumbsup:
